name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA that lets each party disclose confidential information to the other for an agreed purpose, covering use and protection of confidential information, exceptions, term, and return or destruction of confidential information upon termination.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A standard SaaS/cloud services agreement covering access and use of the cloud service, support, restrictions, privacy and security, payment and taxes, term and termination, warranties, limitation of liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: A companion SLA to the Cloud Service Agreement that defines uptime and support response time targets, how they are calculated, and the service credit remedies available if those targets are not met.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement for giving an early-access design partner use of a product in exchange for feedback, covering product access, the feedback program, fees, term and termination, confidentiality, and intellectual property.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A master services agreement for statement-of-work-based professional services, covering delivery of services, intellectual property in deliverables, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, insurance, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A GDPR/UK GDPR-oriented DPA governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and processor/subprocessor, including subprocessors, international data transfers, security incident response, audits, and deletion of personal data.

name: Software License Agreement
description: A license agreement for on-premises or installed software, covering the license grant, restrictions, open source software, updates, payment, term and termination, warranties, limitation of liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A flexible agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, optional fees, a trademark license for co-marketing, an escalation procedure for disputes, term and termination, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA business associate agreement governing a business associate's use and protection of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, including safeguards, subcontractors, breach notification, and term and termination.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial/evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement, covering pilot access, term and termination, disclaimers, limitation of liability, and confidentiality.

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum that supplements a primary agreement to govern the use of AI services, covering input/output handling, restrictions on use, model training permissions, intellectual property and privacy, and AI-specific disclaimers.
